name: Special Delivery
source:
"Special Delivery" is a science fiction short story by American writer Damon Knight. It first appeared in the April 1954 issue of Galaxy Science Fiction and has been reprinted a number of times, in Operation Future (1955), Far Out (1961), and The Best of Damon Knight (1976).

Len and Moira Connington are expecting a baby. Provide them to the happy delivery, or follow the story.

[From [url=https://ileks.itch.io/specialdelivery]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《特快专递》是美国作家达蒙·奈特创作的科幻短篇小说。它首次出现在1954年4月号的《银河科幻小说》中，并在《未来行动》（1955年）、《遥远的未来》（1961年）和《达蒙·奈特精选集》（1976年）中多次重印。

莱恩·克林顿和莫伊拉·克林顿即将生下孩子。将它们提供给快乐交付，或者跟随故事。

[来自[url=https://ileks.itch.io/specialdelivery]Itch.io[/url]]
